next_minimal_consumer.proposed_module_role: Source-specific finite pushforward consumer of existing full-Code compression; proposal outline only, no source authored.
next_minimal_consumer.parameters: M>=2; one supplied z/alpha/atom/beta with z<1 and hmass/htail, before source quantifiers; arbitrary finite N, Copy, sample, admitted s, original population i, CoLocated N s i, liveCard s<=M; arbitrary output carrier Y with DecidableEq (or classical equality), one fixed reader R : Code N sample -> Y, and any output y. No Fintype Y premise.
next_minimal_consumer.definition: readQuotient(M,s,R,y,z) := sum d : Code N sample, if R d = y then populationQuotient N M s d z else 0. Instantiate R d = ((state d).register, rootForest N d), or the same reader after erasing exactly the private coordinate. The actual image Finset.univ.image R is finite because Code is finite; do not assume the ambient Finset (UnrankedTree Copy) type is finite. No Code cardinality factor is inserted.
next_minimal_consumer.statement: For every y, sum a alpha[a]*readQuotient(M,s,R,y,z[a]) = sum b beta[b]*readQuotient(M,s,R,y,z[atom[b]]). One atom certificate is chosen once before N/sample/s/i/R/y, not once per forest or count.
proof_route: Expand finite fibre sum; commute the two finite sums and multiplication; in each d branch apply accepted original_population_compression; fold the fibre sum. No new full-forest coefficient engine.
Apply cappedPolynomial_actual to bind the fibre of P_M(z) to the actual full forest/register PMF, using PMF.map_apply and finite toReal sums. Preserve nonnegative physical PMF and delta fibre.

Use actual_single_exit_unranked_label_view + actual_unranked_epoch_row_independent for representative independence at the same physical population and register; reuse full-forest reader reconstruction rather than infer kernel well-definedness from count alone.

Lift cap-only L1 remainder by finite partition triangle inequality: sum y in Finset.univ.image R, abs(readQuotient(y,z)-readGenerator(y)) <= coarseRemainder M*(1-z). Outside this finite reader image all fibres are empty. Retain separate 1/2 when translating row L1 to TV.

For a proper inside panel, first restrict to actual current roots under existing G1 current-panel law; compose the full-forest reader with graftUnranked; use existing conditional exterior product/context at SeparatedAgenda and integrate the identical correlated prior. No rescaling of other active populations.

count_and_minimal_polynomial_boundary.count_generator: Accepted ordered-choice generator plus population_choice_card and merger_destination_card yields the count reader: for k>=2, choose(k,2)*(delta_{k-1}-delta_k); terminal k=0,1 is zero. This finite reader composition is feasible; not newly kernel-checked here.
count_and_minimal_polynomial_boundary.minimal_polynomial: On capped forest states, accepted spectral levels are {choose(j,2):j<=M}. A matrix annihilator over distinct levels would require a separate operator/quotient composition proof. No accepted minpoly endpoint was identified in the bounded source screen. Do not infer equality to a minimal polynomial from spectral support alone. B already consumes the stronger per-destination coordinates and bypasses this missing formal statement.
count_and_minimal_polynomial_boundary.sharp_count_conditioning: Actual sourceJumpStep/sourceJumpChoice is the existing clock-winner law. Under CoLocated, rates cancel to uniform ordered choices; holding rates depend only on counts. The exact factorization P(s,d;z)=w(s,liveCard d,d)*p_{k,liveCard d}(z) with w nonnegative/normalized remains the source-connected proof needed for Appendix A sharp R_M. A/B coarse transfer does not claim that sharp coefficient norm.

scope_guards: Full-Code and full-forest equality is for the same actual source and fixed reader. It is not an assertion that the compressed signed generator itself is a legal positive source factor.

No ambient Fintype of rooted forests is required: all linear fibre sums are over the actual finite Code carrier, and output row sums use its finite image. This is the source-specific quotient carrier, not arbitrary unbounded trees.
No normalization over the full inherited Code universe is needed to choose atoms; summing over it is a mathematical finite proof interface, not a requested executable giant enumeration.

Whole-source proper outside panels require actual local-carrier restriction/current-root grafting + conditional context. All-copy CoLocated cannot silently be applied to a global state with outside active populations.

Compressed atoms retain original survival values; arbitrary-real existence remains noncomputable. Rational given certificates are already checked, but native-parser/RREF refinement and rational calendar rates for exponential survival are separate.

Positive baseline + Euler/Poisson/semigroup approximation, strictly positive binary graph factors, same-endpoint allocation/shared bank and legal source splice remain downstream. A zero residual is algebraic identity, never a positive physical edge.
Timed/constant-bin decoder and private-seed no-read/future erasure need their existing exact guards; no forest-only mixture is asserted for a fixed Code with stored private bit.

declared_heads.name: positive_tail_compression
declared_heads.header:
theorem positive_tail_compression {n : ℕ} (M : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M)
    (z alpha : Fin n → ℝ) (halpha : ∀ a, 0 ≤ alpha a) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ M - 1 ∧ ∃ atom : Fin r → Fin n, ∃ beta : Fin r → ℝ,
      (∀ b, 0 < beta b) ∧ (∑ b, beta b) = ∑ a, alpha a ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (M - 2),
        (∑ a, alpha a * tailVector M (z a) j) =
          ∑ b, beta b * tailVector M (z (atom b)) j

declared_heads.name: all_level_moments
declared_heads.header:
theorem all_level_moments {n r : ℕ} (M : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M)
    (z alpha : Fin n → ℝ) (atom : Fin r → Fin n) (beta : Fin r → ℝ)
    (hmass : (∑ b, beta b) = ∑ a, alpha a)
    (htail : ∀ q : Fin (M - 2),
      (∑ a, alpha a * tailVector M (z a) q) =
        ∑ b, beta b * tailVector M (z (atom b)) q)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M) :
    (∑ a, alpha a * geometricSum (j.choose 2) (z a)) =
      ∑ b, beta b * geometricSum (j.choose 2) (z (atom b))

declared_heads.header:
theorem actual_joint_context_law {History Obs : Type*}
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) {sample : Copy → X} (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (inside outside : Finset Copy) (ops : List (ProgramStep N)) (s : Code N sample)
    (hpart : inside ∪ outside = (state s).live) (hdis : Disjoint inside outside)
    (hagenda : SeparatedAgenda N r inside outside ops s) (history : History)
    (continuation : History → (V → Bool) → SelectedView V E Copy → SelectedView V E Copy →
      Finset (UnrankedTree Copy) → PMF Obs) :
    (sourceProgram N r ops s).bind (fun d => continuation history (state d).register
      (selectedView (state d) inside) (selectedView (state d) outside) (rootForest N d)) =
    (independentProduct
      (currentPanelProgramLaw N r ops s inside (hpart ▸ Finset.subset_union_left))
      (currentPanelProgramLaw N r ops s outside (hpart ▸ Finset.subset_union_right))).bind
        (fun v => continuation history (state s).register v.1 v.2
          (assembledOriginalForest (state s).genealogy v))

declared_heads.header:
theorem actual_correlated_entering_joint_context_law {History Obs : Type*}
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) {sample : Copy → X} (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (ops : List (ProgramStep N)) (prior : PMF (History × Code N sample))
    (inside outside : Code N sample → Finset Copy)
    (hpart : ∀ a ∈ prior.support, inside a.2 ∪ outside a.2 = (state a.2).live)
    (hdis : ∀ a ∈ prior.support, Disjoint (inside a.2) (outside a.2))
    (hagenda : ∀ a ∈ prior.support, SeparatedAgenda N r (inside a.2) (outside a.2) ops a.2)
    (continuation : History → (V → Bool) → SelectedView V E Copy → SelectedView V E Copy →
      Finset (UnrankedTree Copy) → PMF Obs) :
    prior.bindOnSupport (fun a _ => (sourceProgram N r ops a.2).bind (fun d =>
      continuation a.1 (state d).register (selectedView (state d) (inside a.2))
        (selectedView (state d) (outside a.2)) (rootForest N d))) =
    prior.bindOnSupport (fun a ha => (independentProduct
      (currentPanelProgramLaw N r ops a.2 (inside a.2) ((hpart a ha) ▸ Finset.subset_union_left))
      (currentPanelProgramLaw N r ops a.2 (outside a.2) ((hpart a ha) ▸ Finset.subset_union_right))).bind
        (fun v => continuation a.1 (state a.2).register v.1 v.2
          (assembledOriginalForest (state a.2).genealogy v)))
